description_en: Call the DescribeSourceServers operation to query information about one or more migration sources
description_zh: 调用DescribeSourceServers查询一个或多个迁移源信息
kebab_example: aliyun smc describe-source-servers --job-id j-bp19vlwm0tyigbmj0000 --state Available --name testSourceServerName --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --source-id s-bp1e2fsl57knvuug0000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmw3ty5y70000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --related-job-type Server --workgroup-id w-bp1ja22kdqphehlj0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSourceServers

parameters.help_en: The ID of the migration task
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
The state of the source server. Valid values:

Unavailable: The source server is unavailable. This includes offline and error states.

Available: The source server is online.

InUse: The source server is being migrated.

Deleting: The source server is being deleted
parameters.help_zh:
迁移源状态。取值范围：

Unavailable：不可用，包括离线和出错。
Available：在线。
InUse：迁移中。
Deleting：删除中
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en:
The name of the source server. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter and cannot start with \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh:
迁移源名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http:\//和https:\//开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）。

默认值：空
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
返回的迁移源列表的页码。起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。最大值：50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source server. You can specify multiple IDs
parameters.name: source_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

element_fields.help_en:
The key of tag N. N can be an integer from 1 to 20.

The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length. It cannot start with \`aliyun\` or \`acs:\` and cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`
element_fields.help_zh:
为SMC资源指定的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http:\//或者https:\//
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en:
The value of tag N. N can be an integer from 1 to 20.

The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 64 characters in length. It cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`
element_fields.help_zh:
为SMC资源指定的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。

一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能包含http:\//或者https:\//
element_fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The type of the associated task
parameters.name: related_job_type
